name: Tsuchinaga-san
source:
Tsuchinaga is [url=/c79]Inori's[/url] parrot that can speak the Japanese language fluently and has several-decades-old knowledge. He seems to like a certain girl.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tsuyokiss]Wikipedia[/url]]
